verdict.rationale: Stark Bank's get-started docs reference handling its own webhook events [stark-bank-docs-20], which points to a first-party event-driven notification mechanism. Nothing in the pack covers balance reads, holds, pending activity, or which transaction state changes fire events. missing for 10: documented balance endpoint reflecting holds/pending activity, evidence that webhooks cover every transaction state change, webhook registration/delivery details (retries, signatures, ordering), independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time ledger mirroring.
